verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is code-first, so an agent can create scenes and nodes and edit properties through the documented TypeScript/JS scene-graph API. It can also run headless via NullEngine and server-side support. However, nothing in the evidence shows a scriptable interface for driving the editors themselves (Inspector, Playground, NME) or for triggering builds, and probes find no OpenAPI and no official MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented editor automation/scripting API, programmatic build triggering, an official agent-facing interface (MCP/API), and independent corroboration of agent-driven workflows.
